
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xize766/p/19774862/bp-use2" title="发布于 2026-03-26 11:22">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Burpsuite之暴力破解+验证码识别 | 添柴不加火</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        暴力破解遇到图形验证码就不行了？本文手把手带你识别验证码+暴力破解，小白也能迅速上手。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p></p><div class="toc"><div class="toc-container-header">目录</div><ul><li><a href="#前言" rel="noopener nofollow">前言</a></li><li><a href="#爆破教程" rel="noopener nofollow">爆破教程</a></li></ul></div><p></p>
<h2 id="前言">前言</h2>
<p><code>温馨提示：本文仅供学习参考，一切攻击行为均在靶场中演示，任何违法行为均与作者无关！</code><br>
在练习之前请确保bp中已安装验证码识别插件。<br>
注意：文本首发于公众号“希泽766”</p>
<h2 id="爆破教程">爆破教程</h2>
<p>1、开启bp，打开内置浏览器，输入靶场地址<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111358378-239994429.png" alt="640" loading="lazy"><br>
2、开启抓包拦截，刷新验证码进行抓包<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111424980-1678857103.png" alt="640 (1)" loading="lazy"><br>
3、关闭拦截，将抓到的验证码请求包发送到识别插件<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111442092-1151420806.png" alt="640 (2)" loading="lazy"><br>
4、开启本地服务并配置插件识别模板<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111501237-1430033214.png" alt="640 (3)" loading="lazy"><br>
5、配置关键字和session_id，每个验证码都匹配一个session_id，写正则提取session_id，爆破前别忘记开启插件<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111516018-1218775146.png" alt="640 (4)" loading="lazy"><br>
6、再次开启拦截，抓取登录请求包<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111531494-303663657.png" alt="640 (5)" loading="lazy"><br>
7、发送到intruder模块<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111545916-610111078.png" alt="640 (6)" loading="lazy"><br>
8、攻击类型选第三个，具体作用不在介绍<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111618612-405008694.png" alt="640 (7)" loading="lazy"><br>
9、对用户名、密码、验证码添加变量，然后session_id填写插件名，匹配提取的新session_id（后来发现用户名就是admin，不需要对用户名添加变量）<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111632466-1962059023.png" alt="640 (8)" loading="lazy"><br>
10、特别注意，用户名、密码的payload类型载入字典，但是验证码的payload类型选插件，然后再选择验证码识别插件<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111702211-315772495.png" alt="640 (9)" loading="lazy"><br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111736123-1468472287.png" alt="640 (13)" loading="lazy"><br>
11、配置攻击线程，每次最大攻击请求数设置为1，时间间隔120毫秒，这是为了给插件识别验证码的缓冲时间，确保验证码识别无误<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111718030-1808877627.png" alt="640 (10)" loading="lazy"><br>
12、配置完成点击开始攻击，等待攻击完成，对响应长度进行降序处理，观察其响应，发现爆破成功<br>
<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3763804/202603/3763804-20260326111808242-2117620718.png" alt="640 (12)" loading="lazy"></p>
<hr>
<p>至此，本文爆破教程结束，感谢支持！</p>
